TLDR News.title: ByteDance debuts Seedream 5.0 Pro with advanced reasoning (2 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Seedream 5.0 Pro is a multimodal image-creation model that offers precise edits, multilingual support, and advanced production-design features. It is designed for production design work rather than one-shot image output. The model is targeted at creators, designers, marketers, educators, product teams, and developers. It supports more than 10 languages, as well as some right-to-left layouts and accents.

TLDR News.title: GPT-Live (8 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: OpenAI introduced a full-duplex voice model that can listen and speak simultaneously, handle natural conversational cues, and delegate complex tasks to GPT-5.5 while maintaining the flow of dialogue.

TLDR News.title: Grok 4.5 (3 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.5 as its strongest model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, noting that it was trained alongside Cursor.

TLDR News.title: Meta launches Muse Image across its apps (3 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Muse Image is an image-generation model that can create and edit images. It is now available in the Meta AI app, Instagram Stories, and WhatsApp. The model can perform multi-reference composition, room redesigns, prompt-based image creation and editing, and more. It can draw from public Instagram photos when a user tags an account. There will be an invisible watermark in the images it generates.

TLDR News.title: Auditing the Reliability of Coding Benchmarks (9 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: OpenAI examined SWE-Bench Pro's construction, model failures, and task metadata, concluding that roughly 30% of its public tasks were broken. The analysis showed how flawed evaluations could distort assessments of coding ability, safety, and model progress.

TLDR News.title: A Taxonomy of Self-evolving Agents (15 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Shilong Liu proposes a taxonomy that classifies self-evolving agents into three categories: artifact optimization, harness self-improvement, and model learning. The framework distinguishes whether evolution occurs in outputs, agent infrastructure, or model weights, providing a common language for emerging agent research.

TLDR News.title: An off switch for dual use knowledge in AI models (8 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: GRAM (Gradient-Routed Auxiliary Modules) enables the benefits of training many separately-filtered models at the cost of training only one model. It gives models dedicated, removable compartments for each category of dual-use knowledge and only updates those compartments when learning from dual-use data. It allows parts of the model's knowledge to be deleted after training, providing a stronger framework for model safety.

TLDR News.title: SWE-1.7: Frontier Intelligence at a Fraction of the Cost (22 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: SWE-1.7 reaches frontier-level intelligence at a much lower cost. It is the result of broad improvements across Cognition's RL pipeline, including better infrastructure, more stable training, higher-quality data, and new techniques for long-horizon tasks. The model is available now in Devin on the web, desktop, and CLI. This post contains details on the infrastructure, algorithms, and data work behind the model.

TLDR News.title: Data for Agents (6 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: NVIDIA underscores the importance of open and synthetic data for developing robust AI agents, highlighting its use in the Nemotron datasets for enhancing capabilities like reasoning and tool use. Open datasets contribute to AI system transparency and reproducibility, allowing developers to inspect and understand agent behavior.

TLDR News.title: SambaNova hits $11 billion valuation as investors back Nvidia chip challengers (4 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: SambaNova has raised $1 billion in financing at a valuation of $11 billion. Its inference chip business is scaling fast, and the capital will allow it to really accelerate the deployment of the racks that customers want. The company sells its latest chip as part of a server unit that can be deployed in data centers. It is strongly considering an IPO in 2027.

TLDR News.title: Data At The Edge (9 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: AI is unlocking valuable datasets from the physical world by combining cheaper sensors, robotics, and multimodal models. New data flywheels around infrastructure, healthcare, and industrial automation could create the next generation of enduring AI businesses.

TLDR News.title: OpenAI buys Northslope to put its engineers inside your business (2 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: The purchase of Northslope, an applied-AI firm, adds hundreds of forward-deployed engineers to OpenAI's ranks.

TLDR News.title: Robostral Navigate: single-camera AI navigation (5 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Mistral's Robostral Navigate is an 8B AI model that enables robots to autonomously navigate environments using a single RGB camera.

TLDR News.title: You're not ambitious enough with Claude (11 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Claude delivers the most leverage when used for high-impact work rather than routine automation.

TLDR News.title: Google Photos Added AI-Powered Video Remixing (1 minute read)
TLDR News.excerpt: Google Photos has introduced a Gemini Omni-powered tool that can quickly relight clips, replace backgrounds, and apply artistic styles such as watercolor, sketchbook, and oil painting.
